standard_prerequisites.name: The separable-first subfield of a finitely generated field extension (Fields, Lemma fields-lemma-separable-first, canonical tag 030K)
standard_prerequisites.use: Exhibits k tensor kappa(x) as a product of local factors each of degree equal to the inseparable degree, proving the key length equality.

standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback formula for lengths along flat ring maps (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-pullback-module, canonical tag 02M1)
standard_prerequisites.use: Transports the identity from the algebraic closure base change back to the original tensor product, using flatness of the map between tensor products.

core_obligations: Show that for g : S' to S a morphism of locally Noetherian schemes with X' = S' times_S X and projection g' : X' to X, the weighting of the base change satisfies w_{g^*alpha} = w_alpha composed with g' (proof lines 1677-1719). Fix x' in X' with images s', s, x in S', S, X; the coefficient of [x'] in the base change of [x] by the extension kappa(s')/kappa(s) is the length of the local ring (kappa(s') tensor_{kappa(s)} kappa(x))_q at the prime q corresponding to x', so compatibility reduces to the displayed identity kappa(x) over kappa(s) inseparable degree equals that length times the inseparable degree of kappa(x') over kappa(s') (proof lines 1678-1688). To prove it, let k over kappa(s') be an algebraic closure and choose a prime p of k tensor_{kappa(s)} kappa(x) lying over q; it suffices to prove the two equalities expressing each inseparable degree as a length of a localized tensor product against k, because the product of the two lengths factors as length at q times length at p over the algebraic closure equals length at p, by algebra-lemma-pullback-module (tag 02M1) and flatness of the map kappa(s') tensor kappa(x) to k tensor kappa(x) (proof lines 1689-1707). Finally, with the subfield kappa(x)/kappa/kappa(s) constructed in fields-lemma-separable-first (tag 030K), the tensor product k tensor kappa(x) decomposes as the product over embeddings of k tensor_{kappa, kappa(x)} factors, each local of degree equal to the inseparable degree of kappa(x) over kappa(s), establishing the first equality, and the second is the same statement for kappa(x') over kappa(s') whose purely inseparable part is controlled by the same factorization (proof lines 1708-1718).
proof_roadmap: Unfold the weighting definition at x' and reduce to the displayed length-times-inseparable-degree identity (proof lines 1678-1688).
Base change to an algebraic closure of kappa(s'): the identity factors through two length equalities whose product follows from the pullback formula and flatness (proof lines 1689-1707).
Prove the length equalities with the separable-first subfield decomposition into local factors of inseparable degree (proof lines 1708-1718).
